levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: «الشيخ الجليل» and «رضي الله عنه» are honorifics, left out
«محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد» and «محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men, each with its own «حدثنا» / «عن» (rule 7 counter-example)
The Imam is named only in the words after the chain («ألواح من أبي إبراهيم موسى»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
THQ's English sanad adds «Ali ibn Sinan» and a second «Ali»; the Arabic has neither (see fixes)

fixes.reason: The English sanad names two extra transmitters (Ali ibn Sinan, and a second Ali) that the Arabic chain does not write.

evidence.quote: وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَنانٍ؛ وَعَلِىِّ بْنِ الحَكَمِ
Muhammad ibn Sinan, Ali ibn Sinan, and Ali, on the authority of al-Hakam
